text: 10 OVERDOSAGE Incidents of acute overdosage of nitrofurantoin have resulted in symptoms such as vomiting. Induction of emesis is recommended. There is no specific antidote, but a high fluid intake should be maintained to promote urinary excretion of the drug. Nitrofurantoin is dialyzable.

10 OVERDOSAGE Incidents of acute overdosage of nitrofurantoin oral suspension have resulted in symptoms such as vomiting. Induction of emesis is recommended. There is no specific antidote, but a high fluid intake should be maintained to promote urinary excretion of the drug. Nitrofurantoin is dialyzable.
